changes: Phone: the menu is a slim bar of icons; its button slides the full menu over the page when you need it
About MEDUSA (⋯ menu, or tap the version): the version, its release date, what's new and how your data is protected
Dev tools (in the menu, with the Logs as a tab): version check, speed, storage on this device, speed-ups, clean-up (clear the cache, temporary data, settings) and a diagnostic report
A newer version is noticed while MEDUSA is open, and a small bar offers to reload
Chart: the chosen trade's label sits above the candles instead of on them, and the legend folds to one line
